verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own docs offer SDKs, step-by-step integration guides, a hosted payment page, and sandbox test keys for simulating payments before going live, which covers the core of a docs-driven payment integration. But nothing shows per-language copy-paste code samples, which languages the SDKs cover, or that a working flow can be built in under a day. Missing for 10: evidenced copy-paste code examples in multiple named languages, a list of supported SDK languages, and independent or hands-on proof that integration takes under a day.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Follow step-by-step instructions to integrate Flutterwave into your application.
Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox, then switch to live keys and start accepting real payments.
Use a [library](/docs/directory) if you do not want to build requests by hand.
Create a hosted payment page and redirect your customer to it to pay.
